package.name: uav_perception
package.description:
What the camera sees, interpreted. detector_node runs the trained YOLO11n buoy detector and serves an annotated view for the operator.
It OWNS NO DEVICE. uav_camera holds the one RTSP connection, the one SIYI socket and the one recording writer; this package consumes the MJPEG stream that node already serves. That separation is the point, and uav_camera's own description asks for it: a detector that crashes or exhausts the GPU must not be able to stop the recording, which is the artifact a flight exists to produce.
It writes nothing to disk. Annotated frames live only in the stream — burning boxes into saved imagery would teach the next model that a buoy is a thing with a rectangle around it.
Needs torch and ultralytics, so it runs on the uav:ml image and import-fails loudly anywhere else. That is preferable to falling back to CPU and looking like a broken camera.
